BiblicalUsage: Kattath is a city of Zebulun. It is named among the twelve cities with their villages: Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem.
TheologicalSignificance: A single mention still marks a real town, fixed in the lot of Zebulun.
